pages.text: $(bold)Same-dimension loss:$() loss = base + distance x per-block, growing linearly with the straight-line distance between port and terminal, capped.$(bold)Cross-dimension loss:$() fixed (distance ignored), but you $(bold)must$() place a Dim Bridge component inside the structure to enable cross-dimension transfer.$(br2)$(bold)Directional reduction:$() Input/Output Loss Suppression components cut the loss of that direction by 5% each, up to 90%.

$(bold)Chunk loading:$() the terminal softly loads the chunk of every online port by default so remote transfer persists; place a Chunk Loader framework to enable it.$(bold)Range extension:$() the Chunk Range component widens the loaded area from 1x1 to 3x3 chunks around each port.$(br2)$(bold)Components:$() the Wireless Component item is the crafting material for the portable terminal and identity cards.
